# Partner with foodguys
# Supplying Bulk Ingredients By The Pallet, Truckload, and Container

Bulk Ingredients, industrial ingredient sourcing, negotiating, transporting, and delivering the bulk
industrial ingredients you need from our vast worldwide networks - foodguys is your one-stop-shop!
We have the resources and expertise to provide you with all-encompassing ingredient solutions to
your industrial ingredient needs. is a bulk ingredient supplier for manufacturers in the food and
beverage (human-grade, baby, and pet food), personal care, beauty, and nutraceutical industry. In
addition, foodguys works with retailers, distributors, food service operators to provide bulk
ingredient sourcing, ingredient solutions, and streamline processes related to ingredient
procurement, transportation, and storage. 


It is our job as foodguys to make your job easier.


Think of it this way: foodguys has been doing this since '91, and in that time we have established
relationships and networks that span the entire globe. We have rock-solid relationships with
vendors, transportation, warehouses, and most importantly, a team that truly understands the process
from start to finish.


Our resources allow us to pass high-volume/low-cost per unit order prices on to you. Our MOQs with
our partners begin at one pallet (2,000 lbs). And the best part? We consider ourselves part of your
team, so we will actively seek out additional ways for your organization to improve.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

FOOD, POLYMER & PERSONAL CARE SOLUTIONS

# Welcome to our World of Emulsifiers and Stabilisers

[FOOD][32][POLYMERS][33][PERSONAL CARE][34]

With over a century of experience, we help customers create high-performing products and solve
formulation challenges through tailored solutions and close collaboration. Across food, polymers,
and personal care, our products support sustainability by reducing waste, improving raw material
efficiency, and extending shelf life – helping manufacturers optimise production and contribute to
responsible innovation.

Expertise and innovation 

Since 1917, Palsgaard has led the way in emulsifier development, inventing the world’s first
plant-based food emulsifier. Our specialists now operate from nine global application centres,
delivering tailored solutions for food, polymers, and personal care. From enhancing product
performance to exploring new trends and reformulating for changing market needs, we blend deep
technical expertise with a collaborative approach to deliver lasting value.

Driving ESG together

Responsibility and ESG are deeply ingrained in Palsgaard’s heritage. We help customers reduce food
waste, optimise raw material use, and extend shelf life, while also aiming to lower carbon emissions
and improve production practices. Within our own operations, we invest in renewable energy,
responsible sourcing, and resource efficiency, continually setting ambitious targets to benefit
people, planet, and society. Our RSPO SG-certified emulsifiers and alternatives can help you meet
your ESG goals and regulatory requirements.

Collaborative partnerships

We believe business is personal. By working closely with our customers, we gain a deep understanding
of your goals and challenges, co-creating solutions that make a real difference. Whether you’re
launching a new product, refining a process, or tackling production issues, our experts are with you
every step of the way. With Palsgaard, you gain more than an ingredient supplier – you gain a
committed partner focused on your success.

# Your First API Call

The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the
configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares compatible with the
OpenAI/Anthropic API to access the DeepSeek API.

────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PARAM       │VALUE                                                                                  
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_url    │`https://api.deepseek.com`                                                             
(OpenAI)    │                                                                                       
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_url    │`https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`                                                   
(Anthropic) │                                                                                       
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
api_key     │apply for an [API key][28]                                                             
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
model^{*}   │`deepseek-v4-flash`                                                                    
            │`deepseek-v4-pro`                                                                      
            │`deepseek-chat` (to be deprecated on 2026/07/24)                                       
            │`deepseek-reasoner` (to be deprecated on 2026/07/24)                                   
────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

* The model names `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` will be deprecated on 2026/07/24 15:59
UTC. For compatibility, they correspond to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of
`deepseek-v4-flash`, respectively.

## Integrate with Agent Tools[][29]

The DeepSeek API is supported by many popular AI agent and coding assistant tools. If you use tools
like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenCode, you can use DeepSeek as the backend model directly —
no code required.

See the [Agent Integrations Guide][30] for details.

## Invoke The Chat API[][31]

Once you have obtained an API key, you can access the DeepSeek model using the following example
scripts in the OpenAI API format. This is a non-stream example, you can set the `stream` parameter
to `true` to get stream response.

For examples using the Anthropic API format, please refer to [Anthropic API][32].
* curl
* python
* nodejs

`curl https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
        "model": "deepseek-v4-pro",
        "messages": [
          {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
          {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
        ],
        "thinking": {"type": "enabled"},
        "reasoning_effort": "high",
        "stream": false
      }'
`

`# Please install OpenAI SDK first: `pip3 install openai`
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ.get('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'),
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-pro",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"},
    ],
    stream=False,
    reasoning_effort="high",
    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
`

### Limited Liability Companies (LLCs)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Unmatched in flexibility and simplicity, ideal for entrepreneurs who prefer an easy setup and
minimal bureaucracy.

#### Ownership & Management

No limit on owners; flexible management options allow for tailored operational control, suitable for
diverse business models.

#### Taxation Advantages

Benefits from pass-through taxation, with an option for corporate taxation, offering tax flexibility
to members.

#### Liability Protection

Provides strong protection of personal assets from business liabilities, crucial for businesses with
substantial risk.

#### Compliance Requirements

Moderate, with the potential need for reformation upon membership changes, depending on state laws.

#### Financing Options

Suited for funding through member contributions and bank loans, though may face challenges in

### Limited Liability Companies (LLCs)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Unmatched in flexibility and simplicity, ideal for entrepreneurs who prefer an easy setup and
minimal bureaucracy.

#### Ownership & Management

No limit on owners; flexible management options allow for tailored operational control, suitable for
diverse business models.

#### Taxation Advantages

Benefits from pass-through taxation, with an option for corporate taxation, offering tax flexibility
to members.

#### Liability Protection

Provides strong protection of personal assets from business liabilities, crucial for businesses with
substantial risk.

#### Compliance Requirements

Moderate, with the potential need for reformation upon membership changes, depending on state laws.

#### Financing Options

Suited for funding through member contributions and bank loans, though may face challenges in
attracting external investors.

#### Great Choice For

Entrepreneurs and startups seeking operational flexibility, personal liability protection, and tax
options, especially in high-risk sectors.

### S-Corporations (S-Corps)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Balances corporate structure with operational flexibility, subject to certain formalities for tax
status maintenance.

#### Ownership & Management

Capped at 100 shareholders who must be U.S. residents, introducing limitations on investment
diversity and scale.

#### Taxation Advantages

Offers pass-through taxation to avoid double taxation, with benefits for salary and dividend tax
planning.

#### Liability Protection

Ensures shareholders’ personal assets are protected from company liabilities, providing a safeguard
for personal wealth.

#### Compliance Requirements

Strict IRS criteria for S-Corp status, including operational guidelines and reporting standards.

#### Financing Options

Access to capital through a single class of stock and loans, with some limitations compared to
C-Corps.

#### Great Choice For

Small to medium businesses that meet the IRS requirements, looking for tax advantages without the
complexity of a C-Corp.

### C-Corporations (C-Corps)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Faces the highest level of regulatory and operational requirements, ideal for those able to navigate
complex structures.

#### Ownership & Management

Unlimited ownership with no nationality restrictions, allowing for global investment opportunities.

#### Taxation Advantages

Encounters corporate taxation and potential double taxation on dividends, offset by a wider range of
deductible business expenses.

#### Liability Protection

Offers maximum protection for owners from personal liability, a critical factor for businesses with
significant risk exposure.

#### Compliance Requirements

Demands extensive record-keeping, governance standards, and shareholder meetings, suited for

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,
the form that is absorbed most efficiently.

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

# Dübör Backtrenn­mittel

## Sprühen, backen, lösen, gut!

Uns verbindet, was gut trennt: Mit unseren Trennmitteln für die Backwarenindustrie,
Süßwarenproduktion, Fleischindustrie und Pharmabranche sorgen wir bereits seit über 60 Jahren für
reibungslose Abläufe in der Produktion von großen und kleineren Betrieben. Inzwischen beliefern wir
die unterschiedlichsten Produktionen weltweit. Und das mit gleichbleibend hochwertiger Qualität und
Service, auf den Sie sich verlassen können. Bei unseren Trennmittellösungen steht immer Ihr Produkt
im Mittelpunkt. Deshalb liefern wir nicht nur das richtige Trennmittel für Ihre individuelle
Produktion, sondern auch die passende Sprühtechnik dazu. Ob Befettung von Formen und Blechen,
Schalen und Bändern oder das Lösen der Back- oder Süßwaren aus Formen: Ihr Produkt ist der Star, wir
sorgen für den reibungslosen Ablauf bis zum großen Auftritt!

[ [Home]
Trennmittel

Unsere Trennmittel-Sprühtechnik liefert immer ein sicheres Ergebnis ohne Verschwendung oder
Wartungsaufwand – in der verwinkelten Backstube genauso wie in der industriellen Fertigungshalle.

Mehr erfahren [dübör background]
][36]
[ [Home]
Sprühtechnik

Unsere Trennmittel-Sprühtechnik liefert immer ein sicheres Ergebnis ohne Verschwendung oder
Wartungsaufwand – in der verwinkelten Backstube genauso wie in der industriellen Fertigungshalle.

Mehr erfahren [dübör background]
][37]

## Was uns auszeichnet

Gleichbleibend gute Qualität für handwerkliche und industrielle Backbetriebe sowie die
Lebensmittelindustrie: Für die Fertigung der Dübör Trennmittel kontrollieren wir jedes angelieferte
Rohmaterial sofort nach der Ankunft und danach während des gesamten Veredelungsprozesses.

[ Mehr erfahren ][38]

Als Familienunternehmen ist es uns wichtig, Ressourcen für zukünftige Generationen zu bewahren. Mit
unseren Bio-Trennmitteln und dem Verzicht auf Palmöl folgen nicht nur einem Trend, sondern unserer
Überzeugung.

[ Mehr erfahren ][39]

Von der Beratung zur besten Trennmittel-Lösung, über den anforderungsgerechten Bau einer Sprühanlage
bis hin zur Installation vor Ort: Wer sich für DÜBÖR-Qualität entscheidet, bekommt den perfekten
Service mitgeliefert.

[ Mehr erfahren ][40]

DÜBÖR steht für vertrauensvolle, langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen. Wir wollen auch für die
Herausforderungen der Zukunft ein leistungsfähiger Partner für Backbetriebe und die
Lebensmittelindustrie sein.

[ Mehr erfahren ][41]

# Welcome to FastMCP

Copy pageCopy page

The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers, clients, and applications.

Copy pageCopy page
**FastMCP is the standard framework for building MCP applications.** The [Model Context
Protocol][27] (MCP) connects LLMs to tools and data. FastMCP gives you everything you need to go
from prototype to production — build servers that expose capabilities, connect clients to any MCP
service, and give your tools interactive UIs:

`from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("Demo 🚀")

@mcp.tool
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two numbers"""
    return a + b

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
`

## [
## ][28]
## Move Fast and Make Things

The [Model Context Protocol][29] (MCP) lets you give agents access to your tools and data. But
building an effective MCP application is harder than it looks. FastMCP handles all of it. Declare a
tool with a Python function, and the schema, validation, and documentation are generated
automatically. Connect to a server with a URL, and transport negotiation, authentication, and
protocol lifecycle are managed for you. You focus on your logic, and the MCP part just works: **with
FastMCP, best practices are built in.** **That’s why FastMCP is the standard framework for working
with MCP.** FastMCP 1.0 was incorporated into the official MCP Python SDK in 2024. Today, the
actively maintained standalone project is downloaded a million times a day, and some version of
FastMCP powers 70% of MCP servers across all languages. FastMCP has three pillars:
[servers-card]

## Servers

Expose tools, resources, and prompts to LLMs.
[apps-card]

## Apps

Give your tools interactive UIs rendered directly in the conversation.
[clients-card]

## Clients

Connect to any MCP server — local or remote, programmatic or CLI.
**[Servers][30]** wrap your Python functions into MCP-compliant tools, resources, and prompts.
**[Clients][31]** connect to any server with full protocol support. And **[Apps][32]** give your
tools interactive UIs rendered directly in the conversation. Ready to build? Start with the
[installation guide][33] or jump straight to the [quickstart][34]. FastMCP is made with 💙 by
[Prefect][35].

## [
## ][36]
## Run FastMCP in production with Horizon

FastMCP is the standard way to build MCP servers. **[Prefect Horizon][37]** is the enterprise MCP
gateway for running them safely. Built by the FastMCP team, Horizon packages the best practices
we’ve learned shipping the world’s most popular MCP framework. Deploy FastMCP servers from GitHub
with branch previews and instant rollback. Create a private registry of every MCP your company uses.
Secure access with SSO and tool-level RBAC. Get audit logs, observability, and governance across
your MCP stack. Remix approved tools into purpose-built endpoints for teams and agents. Start with
FastMCP. [Scale with Horizon →][38]
**This documentation reflects FastMCP’s `main` branch**, meaning it always reflects the latest
development version. Features are generally marked with version badges (e.g. `New in version:
3.0.0`) to indicate when they were introduced. Note that this may include features that are not yet
released.

[installation guide][33] or jump straight to the [quickstart][34]. FastMCP is made with 💙 by
[Prefect][35].

## [
## ][36]
## Run FastMCP in production with Horizon

FastMCP is the standard way to build MCP servers. **[Prefect Horizon][37]** is the enterprise MCP
gateway for running them safely. Built by the FastMCP team, Horizon packages the best practices
we’ve learned shipping the world’s most popular MCP framework. Deploy FastMCP servers from GitHub
with branch previews and instant rollback. Create a private registry of every MCP your company uses.
Secure access with SSO and tool-level RBAC. Get audit logs, observability, and governance across
your MCP stack. Remix approved tools into purpose-built endpoints for teams and agents. Start with
FastMCP. [Scale with Horizon →][38]
**This documentation reflects FastMCP’s `main` branch**, meaning it always reflects the latest
development version. Features are generally marked with version badges (e.g. `New in version:
3.0.0`) to indicate when they were introduced. Note that this may include features that are not yet
released.

## [
## ][39]
## LLM-Friendly Docs

The FastMCP documentation is available in multiple LLM-friendly formats:

### [
### ][40]
### MCP Server

The FastMCP docs are accessible via MCP! The server URL is `https://gofastmcp.com/mcp`. In fact, you
can use FastMCP to search the FastMCP docs:

`import asyncio
from fastmcp import Client

async def main():
    async with Client("https://gofastmcp.com/mcp") as client:
        result = await client.call_tool(
            name="search_fast_mcp",
            arguments={"query": "deploy a FastMCP server"}
        )
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
`

## BAKERY SOLUTIONS

Inspiring bakery solutions

Sonneveld's release agents offer a comprehensive solution for all types of bakeries, industries, and
processes. 


By choosing the right release agent and application method for your specific bakery needs, you can
produce high-quality products more efficiently and cost-effectively. This not only prevents your
products from becoming dirty or damaged but also reduces overall costs and maintains a clean
production environment. Effective release agents minimize the risk of production delays, product
loss, and rejections on the production line. Additionally, they help you adhere to stringent hygiene
standards and enhance the shelf-life of your bakery products.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

### End-to-End intelligence and advisory across industries and functions.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]

# We are global leaders
# in the mold release industry

Our custom-formulated mold release solutions are perfect for a variety of industries and
applications.

[ Get Custom Solutions ][47]

## Over **100 years** of industry experience

With over 100 years of combined experience in the mold release industry, W. N. SHAW &
Co. incorporates a vast range of knowledge, skills and experience in the development and application
of custom-formulated products for customers around the globe.

[View Product Applications][48]

Based in Pacific, Missouri, W. N. SHAW is a leading chemical specialty company offering mold release
agents and related products to customers in a wide range of industries. Our team has over 100 years
of combined experience in mold release development, and we specialize in finding creative solutions
to the challenges that are affecting your manufacturing processes.

Our facilities consist of two domestic manufacturing plants and a fully equipped testing and
analysis lab. From there, our team leverages a vast range of knowledge, skills and experience in the
development and application of custom-formulated products for clients in North America, Asia and
around the globe.

Keep browsing our website to learn more about our background in mold release agents, or [contact our
office][49] directly to find out what we can do for your business.


## Technical Rubber

We specialize in producing the semi-permanent, solvent and water-base products for all types of
rubber compounds and applications.

[Learn More][50]

## Polyurethane

We offer solvent-base, water-base, paste wax, and mold cleaning products for MDI, TDI, and TDI/MDI
for all rigid, flexible, and cast urethane molding industries.

[Learn More][51]

## Rotational Molding

We offer water-base and solvent-base, semi-permanent products formulated for molding linear low,
medium, and high-density and cross-linked polyethylene, nylon 6, nylon 11, and liquid nylon.

[Learn More][52]

## Tire Products

We formulate both solvent and water-base products to meet the requirements of each customer's
application and the standards set forth by the tire industry.

[Learn More][53]

## Rubber Hose/Belting

We custom formulate water-based release lubricants for rubber hose and tube production, for all
mandrel types and pan-cure applications.

[Learn More][54]

## Composite

Our composite molding products provide excellent release with very low build-up while delivering the
desired product surface characteristics.

[Learn More][55]

## Customized & Expertly Crafted
## Molding Agent Solutions

Our core applications include [technical rubber][56], [polyurethane][57], [rotational molding][58],
[tire][59], [rubber hose][60] and [composite mold release agents][61]. As a custom formulator, we
have the agility required to serve any mold release application. Our products include
[semi-permanent solvent][62]– and [water-based mold releases][63], silicone- and VOC-free mold
releases, water-based wax and silicone emulsions, [water-based mandrel releases][64], anti-tack
formulations and more.

With our sophisticated mold release capabilities, we can provide rapid development time and
integrated production to quickly fulfill specialized product needs. In everything we do, our goal is
to add value to our customers’ manufacturing processes through the development of cost-effective
chemical agents formulated with advanced technologies.

[Learn More About what we do][65]

agents and related products to customers in a wide range of industries. Our team has over 100 years

to the challenges that are affecting your manufacturing processes.

analysis lab. From there, our team leverages a vast range of knowledge, skills and experience in the
development and application of custom-formulated products for clients in North America, Asia and
around the globe.

## Molding Agent Solutions

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Your First API Call

The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the
configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares compatible with the
OpenAI/Anthropic API to access the DeepSeek API.

────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PARAM       │VALUE                                                                                  
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_url    │`https://api.deepseek.com`                                                             
(OpenAI)    │                                                                                       
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_url    │`https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`                                                   
(Anthropic) │                                                                                       
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
api_key     │apply for an [API key][28]                                                             
────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
model^{*}   │`deepseek-v4-flash`                                                                    
            │`deepseek-v4-pro`                                                                      
            │`deepseek-chat` (to be deprecated on 2026/07/24)                                       
            │`deepseek-reasoner` (to be deprecated on 2026/07/24)                                   
────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

* The model names `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` will be deprecated on 2026/07/24 15:59
UTC. For compatibility, they correspond to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of
`deepseek-v4-flash`, respectively.

## Integrate with Agent Tools[][29]

The DeepSeek API is supported by many popular AI agent and coding assistant tools. If you use tools
like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenCode, you can use DeepSeek as the backend model directly —
no code required.

See the [Agent Integrations Guide][30] for details.

## Invoke The Chat API[][31]

Once you have obtained an API key, you can access the DeepSeek model using the following example
scripts in the OpenAI API format. This is a non-stream example, you can set the `stream` parameter
to `true` to get stream response.

For examples using the Anthropic API format, please refer to [Anthropic API][32].
* curl
* python
* nodejs

`curl https://api.deepseek.com/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
        "model": "deepseek-v4-pro",
        "messages": [
          {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
          {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
        ],
        "thinking": {"type": "enabled"},
        "reasoning_effort": "high",
        "stream": false
      }'
`

`# Please install OpenAI SDK first: `pip3 install openai`
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ.get('DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'),
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-pro",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant"},
        {"role": "user", "content": "Hello"},
    ],
    stream=False,
    reasoning_effort="high",
    extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
`

`// Please install OpenAI SDK first: `npm install openai`

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Unmatched in flexibility and simplicity, ideal for entrepreneurs who prefer an easy setup and
minimal bureaucracy.

#### Ownership & Management

No limit on owners; flexible management options allow for tailored operational control, suitable for
diverse business models.

#### Taxation Advantages

Benefits from pass-through taxation, with an option for corporate taxation, offering tax flexibility
to members.

#### Liability Protection

Provides strong protection of personal assets from business liabilities, crucial for businesses with
substantial risk.

Moderate, with the potential need for reformation upon membership changes, depending on state laws.

### Limited Liability Companies (LLCs)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Unmatched in flexibility and simplicity, ideal for entrepreneurs who prefer an easy setup and
minimal bureaucracy.

#### Ownership & Management

No limit on owners; flexible management options allow for tailored operational control, suitable for
diverse business models.

#### Taxation Advantages

Benefits from pass-through taxation, with an option for corporate taxation, offering tax flexibility
to members.

#### Liability Protection

Provides strong protection of personal assets from business liabilities, crucial for businesses with
substantial risk.

#### Compliance Requirements

Moderate, with the potential need for reformation upon membership changes, depending on state laws.

#### Financing Options

Suited for funding through member contributions and bank loans, though may face challenges in
attracting external investors.

#### Great Choice For

Entrepreneurs and startups seeking operational flexibility, personal liability protection, and tax
options, especially in high-risk sectors.

### S-Corporations (S-Corps)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Balances corporate structure with operational flexibility, subject to certain formalities for tax
status maintenance.

#### Ownership & Management

Capped at 100 shareholders who must be U.S. residents, introducing limitations on investment
diversity and scale.

#### Taxation Advantages

Offers pass-through taxation to avoid double taxation, with benefits for salary and dividend tax
planning.

#### Liability Protection

Ensures shareholders’ personal assets are protected from company liabilities, providing a safeguard
for personal wealth.

#### Compliance Requirements

Strict IRS criteria for S-Corp status, including operational guidelines and reporting standards.

#### Financing Options

Access to capital through a single class of stock and loans, with some limitations compared to
C-Corps.

#### Great Choice For

Small to medium businesses that meet the IRS requirements, looking for tax advantages without the
complexity of a C-Corp.

### C-Corporations (C-Corps)

#### Flexibility & Operational Ease

Faces the highest level of regulatory and operational requirements, ideal for those able to navigate
complex structures.

#### Ownership & Management

Unlimited ownership with no nationality restrictions, allowing for global investment opportunities.

#### Taxation Advantages

Encounters corporate taxation and potential double taxation on dividends, offset by a wider range of
deductible business expenses.

#### Liability Protection

Offers maximum protection for owners from personal liability, a critical factor for businesses with
significant risk exposure.

#### Compliance Requirements

Demands extensive record-keeping, governance standards, and shareholder meetings, suited for

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

### How Omega-3 Free Fatty Acids Improve Absorption

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine
supplementation, providing a safe and reliable source of iodine ions for a wide range of nutritional
applications.
[Read Article][124]

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and
reliable performance for flexible packaging applications.
[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

# Dübör Backtrenn­mittel

## Sprühen, backen, lösen, gut!

Uns verbindet, was gut trennt: Mit unseren Trennmitteln für die Backwarenindustrie,
Süßwarenproduktion, Fleischindustrie und Pharmabranche sorgen wir bereits seit über 60 Jahren für
reibungslose Abläufe in der Produktion von großen und kleineren Betrieben. Inzwischen beliefern wir
die unterschiedlichsten Produktionen weltweit. Und das mit gleichbleibend hochwertiger Qualität und
Service, auf den Sie sich verlassen können. Bei unseren Trennmittellösungen steht immer Ihr Produkt
im Mittelpunkt. Deshalb liefern wir nicht nur das richtige Trennmittel für Ihre individuelle
Produktion, sondern auch die passende Sprühtechnik dazu. Ob Befettung von Formen und Blechen,
Schalen und Bändern oder das Lösen der Back- oder Süßwaren aus Formen: Ihr Produkt ist der Star, wir
sorgen für den reibungslosen Ablauf bis zum großen Auftritt!

[ [Home]
Trennmittel

Unsere Trennmittel-Sprühtechnik liefert immer ein sicheres Ergebnis ohne Verschwendung oder
Wartungsaufwand – in der verwinkelten Backstube genauso wie in der industriellen Fertigungshalle.

## Was uns auszeichnet

Gleichbleibend gute Qualität für handwerkliche und industrielle Backbetriebe sowie die
Lebensmittelindustrie: Für die Fertigung der Dübör Trennmittel kontrollieren wir jedes angelieferte
Rohmaterial sofort nach der Ankunft und danach während des gesamten Veredelungsprozesses.

[ Mehr erfahren ][38]

Als Familienunternehmen ist es uns wichtig, Ressourcen für zukünftige Generationen zu bewahren. Mit
unseren Bio-Trennmitteln und dem Verzicht auf Palmöl folgen nicht nur einem Trend, sondern unserer
Überzeugung.

[ Mehr erfahren ][39]

Von der Beratung zur besten Trennmittel-Lösung, über den anforderungsgerechten Bau einer Sprühanlage
bis hin zur Installation vor Ort: Wer sich für DÜBÖR-Qualität entscheidet, bekommt den perfekten
Service mitgeliefert.

[ Mehr erfahren ][40]

DÜBÖR steht für vertrauensvolle, langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen. Wir wollen auch für die
Herausforderungen der Zukunft ein leistungsfähiger Partner für Backbetriebe und die
Lebensmittelindustrie sein.

Copy pageCopy page

The fast, Pythonic way to build MCP servers, clients, and applications.

Copy pageCopy page
**FastMCP is the standard framework for building MCP applications.** The [Model Context
Protocol][27] (MCP) connects LLMs to tools and data. FastMCP gives you everything you need to go
from prototype to production — build servers that expose capabilities, connect clients to any MCP
service, and give your tools interactive UIs:

`from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("Demo 🚀")

@mcp.tool
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two numbers"""
    return a + b

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
`

## ][28]
## Move Fast and Make Things

The [Model Context Protocol][29] (MCP) lets you give agents access to your tools and data. But
building an effective MCP application is harder than it looks. FastMCP handles all of it. Declare a
tool with a Python function, and the schema, validation, and documentation are generated
automatically. Connect to a server with a URL, and transport negotiation, authentication, and
protocol lifecycle are managed for you. You focus on your logic, and the MCP part just works: **with
FastMCP, best practices are built in.** **That’s why FastMCP is the standard framework for working
with MCP.** FastMCP 1.0 was incorporated into the official MCP Python SDK in 2024. Today, the
actively maintained standalone project is downloaded a million times a day, and some version of
FastMCP powers 70% of MCP servers across all languages. FastMCP has three pillars:
[servers-card]

## Servers

Expose tools, resources, and prompts to LLMs.
[apps-card]

## Apps

Give your tools interactive UIs rendered directly in the conversation.
[clients-card]

## Clients

Connect to any MCP server — local or remote, programmatic or CLI.
**[Servers][30]** wrap your Python functions into MCP-compliant tools, resources, and prompts.
**[Clients][31]** connect to any server with full protocol support. And **[Apps][32]** give your
tools interactive UIs rendered directly in the conversation. Ready to build? Start with the
[installation guide][33] or jump straight to the [quickstart][34]. FastMCP is made with 💙 by
[Prefect][35].

with branch previews and instant rollback. Create a private registry of every MCP your company uses.
Secure access with SSO and tool-level RBAC. Get audit logs, observability, and governance across
your MCP stack. Remix approved tools into purpose-built endpoints for teams and agents. Start with

Common Questions

## Answers before you ask.

Why choose Macar & Sons?

We've been a premier Mediterranean food import and distribution company since 1995. Because we
import directly instead of reselling, you get better pricing, fresher rotation, and the products
your customers actually ask for — delivered faster.

Do you sell to businesses like mine?

Yes — we supply grocery stores, restaurants, hotels, caterers and food service businesses of every
size, from single-location bistros to large retail chains, with order sizes tailored to your needs.

Are your products Halal?

We carry a wide range of 100% Halal certified products that have passed strict controls from
reputable certifying organizations.

How fast is delivery, and where do you ship?

We deliver nationwide to all 50 states, with orders typically arriving in 1–3 business days from our
tri-temperature warehouse in Pompano Beach, Florida.

Can I see pricing before I order?

Yes — our order portal shows live pricing and real-time product availability, with automated volume
discounts applied as you build your order.

forward-looking decisions.

# We are global leaders
# in the mold release industry

Our custom-formulated mold release solutions are perfect for a variety of industries and
applications.

[ Get Custom Solutions ][47]

## Over **100 years** of industry experience

With over 100 years of combined experience in the mold release industry, W. N. SHAW &
Co. incorporates a vast range of knowledge, skills and experience in the development and application
of custom-formulated products for customers around the globe.

[View Product Applications][48]

Based in Pacific, Missouri, W. N. SHAW is a leading chemical specialty company offering mold release
agents and related products to customers in a wide range of industries. Our team has over 100 years
of combined experience in mold release development, and we specialize in finding creative solutions
to the challenges that are affecting your manufacturing processes.

Our facilities consist of two domestic manufacturing plants and a fully equipped testing and
analysis lab. From there, our team leverages a vast range of knowledge, skills and experience in the
development and application of custom-formulated products for clients in North America, Asia and
around the globe.

Keep browsing our website to learn more about our background in mold release agents, or [contact our
office][49] directly to find out what we can do for your business.


## Technical Rubber

We specialize in producing the semi-permanent, solvent and water-base products for all types of
rubber compounds and applications.

[Learn More][50]

## Polyurethane

We offer solvent-base, water-base, paste wax, and mold cleaning products for MDI, TDI, and TDI/MDI
for all rigid, flexible, and cast urethane molding industries.

[Learn More][51]

## Rotational Molding

We offer water-base and solvent-base, semi-permanent products formulated for molding linear low,
medium, and high-density and cross-linked polyethylene, nylon 6, nylon 11, and liquid nylon.

[Learn More][52]

## Tire Products

We formulate both solvent and water-base products to meet the requirements of each customer's
application and the standards set forth by the tire industry.

[Learn More][53]

## Rubber Hose/Belting

We custom formulate water-based release lubricants for rubber hose and tube production, for all
mandrel types and pan-cure applications.

[Learn More][54]

## Composite

Our composite molding products provide excellent release with very low build-up while delivering the
desired product surface characteristics.

[Learn More][55]

## Customized & Expertly Crafted
## Molding Agent Solutions

Our core applications include [technical rubber][56], [polyurethane][57], [rotational molding][58],
[tire][59], [rubber hose][60] and [composite mold release agents][61]. As a custom formulator, we
have the agility required to serve any mold release application. Our products include
[semi-permanent solvent][62]– and [water-based mold releases][63], silicone- and VOC-free mold
releases, water-based wax and silicone emulsions, [water-based mandrel releases][64], anti-tack
formulations and more.

With our sophisticated mold release capabilities, we can provide rapid development time and
integrated production to quickly fulfill specialized product needs. In everything we do, our goal is
to add value to our customers’ manufacturing processes through the development of cost-effective
chemical agents formulated with advanced technologies.

[Learn More About what we do][65]

## Expertise, Quality & Customer Satisfaction

Since 1995, our reputation has been built on an ongoing commitment to technical expertise,
consistent performance and a dedication to understanding the needs and priorities of every customer
we work with. Typically, these capabilities are utilized for two equally important purposes:

• New product development and quality control — We work closely with automotive, consumer goods and
other manufacturers to develop mold release agents for diverse products such as footwear, windmill
blades, speaker trays and more.

• Problem-solving and customer support — Our services can determine whether the composition of your
products is consistent and within specifications, or whether chemical contamination is present.

Backing up these technical capabilities, our sales and engineering specialists provide efficient,
complete and invaluable attention to our customers' needs, while acting as a communications link to
our product development team. As a result, we can expedite complex jobs and help you meet your
production goals.

Thorough "shop floor" interaction observation and extensive online product testing are vital to the
proper formulation and successful performance of our products. By staying on top of our work and our
industry, we are well-positioned to adapt to the changing mold release requirements of today’s
chemical specialty market. We have invested heavily in green technology, so you can make more
efficient use of materials and run a leaner and cleaner operation overall.
